mirror.means: the figure is the character's own people carried to its pole: figure.tradition equals the character's origin people, or the character's primary domain, and the figure is a villain

arcResonance.means: the figure's role/wants/signature and the personal arc's premise/stakes answer each other (judged by the choosing call from the shortlist, never by keyword alone)

wantsTheirGround.means: the figure leads a power whose seat or reach is within groundWithinDays of any of the character's holdings, and whose verbs include expand, raid, extort or tribute

seatStakes.means: the figure is a seat challenger, the open seat's claimant, a claimant on a refused half, or a Sovereign's agent (SNG-642/644)

throughTheirPeople.means: someone in the character's company, band or holdings' stewards is the figure's rival, opposer or anti-Sovereign hunter — the figure comes for the character through them

kinThreatened.means: a registry person tagged kin (e.g. silas-mother) lives within reach of the figure's power

offscreenProtection: a bound nemesis is not killed by the world tick offscreen: it may be wounded or stopped, never slain, except by the character, by the character's company, or in a scene the character is present for
onNemesisDeath: the next candidate on the shortlist inherits, and the GM is told who and why; a slain nemesis's power or kin may take up the grudge (unavenged)

relations: the legend surfaces into the nemesis's hands
the legend is the only thing that can stop the nemesis
legendTie.rule: the personal arc's final stage is where the tie surfaces; the routes stay the player's (never foreclosed)
